name: io.github.tonyyang0504/lever-mcp
description: Lever (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LEVER_SITE
environmentVariables.description: The company's Lever site name (usually the company name without spaces), e.g. 'leverdemo' in https://jobs.lever.co/leverdemo.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LEVER_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Lever postings host for the site's instance: api.lever.co (global) or api.eu.lever.co (EU).
